TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Grand-Falls Windsor RCMP advises that road conditions in Central are very poor, from Botwood to Buchans and surrounding areas. Roads are snow and slush covered, creating very slippery conditions.

Please consider delaying any non-essential travel until conditions improve. If you must travel tonight, slow down and use caution. Leave yourself extra time and plenty of space from the vehicle ahead of you. Avoid sudden braking and ensure your lights are on so others can see you.

#nltraffic
